name: मराठी
notes: Written on 27 Nov 2026 without a native speaker. Every keyword, yes and no word, prompt, label and sample sentence here still needs a Marathi speaker's check, and no spelling has been compared with real recogniser output yet. The number words in numbers_mr.json come from Unicode CLDR 49; the colloquial forms below do not, and each one is marked as not confirmed. Keep status at beta until the gate in the research plan (A4) is met.
